# SkyrimCoop texts: English (American), the language built into the mod (src/TextEnglish.h, which a test keeps the
# same as this file). A key a language file lacks shows this English text, so a missing or half-done file never
# blanks a message.
#
# One "key = text" per line, in UTF-8 without a byte order mark. A line starting with # is a comment. \n is a
# line break. Keep the {placeholders} ({n}, {plugin}, {you}, {host}) exactly as written: the mod fills them in, and
# the tests check each file has the same ones as the English. The first comment line of every other language says
# how it was made (a machine-translated first pass, or reviewed against the game's own terms).
#
# To correct a language without waiting for an update, put your lines in a file of your own beside the mod's log,
# Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE\SkyrimCoop_lang_<code>.txt: they go over this folder's file for
# that language (dist/INSTALL.md).

reject.unreadable = The join request could not be read.
reject.not_this_mod = This is not a SkyrimCoop game.
reject.version = This game runs another version of the mod (protocol {you}, the host has {host}). Both players need the same version.
reject.password = Wrong password.
reject.full = The game is full ({n} players).
reject.mods = Your mods differ from the host's.

steam.status_hosting = Hosting Skyrim co-op
steam.status_playing = Playing Skyrim co-op
